patch.summary:
Choose Apify only if your buying job matches “Actor platform for web scraping — Free $0 ($5 usage); Starter $29/mo ($26 annual); Scale $” rather than Fly.io's shape. Choose Fly.io only if your buying job matches “Cloud PaaS / microVM app platform — PAYG; shared-cpu-1x from ~$1.94/mo in lower-cost regio” rather than Apify's shape.
